name: cms125v6-breast-cancer-screening
description: CMS125v15 Breast Cancer Screening (2027 performance period): recommends a screening mammogram for women 42-74 who have not had one within the last 27 months.

protocols.description: Identifies women 42-74 with a qualifying visit who are due for a screening mammogram and recommends one. Excludes bilateral mastectomy, mastectomies of both sides, hospice, palliative care, and the age 66+ nursing home and frailty exclusions.

meta.title: Breast Cancer Screening
meta.description: Women 42-74 years of age who have not had a mammogram to screen for breast cancer within the last 27 months.
references: U.S. Preventive Services Task Force. (2024). Screening for breast cancer: US Preventive Services Task Force recommendation statement. JAMA, 331(22), 1918-1930.
